implementation: Set deterministic_output on the existing monolithic trellis kernel so each route writes its own [M,topk,K] BF16 row, then invoke B12X's fixed-order top-k sum kernel. No atomic output scatter is used.

fixed_inputs.product: P8 K4 procedural MCG to E4M3 with physical UE8M0/32 scales

decision_rule: For both M3 and M33, all five outputs must be bitwise identical; the first output must be finite, cosine above 0.995, and relative L2 below 0.12 against the same decoded-weight FP32 reference.
failure_rule: Any differing hash, non-finite result, threshold miss, crash, or missing run fails without reroll.
scope: Determinism plus arithmetic closure only; no speed or end-to-end KLD claim.
